strings: The patrol drives away the gray fox, seeks out her den, and kills her young cubs. It's brutal, but these fluffy baby foxes would one day have grown to be kit-killers and thieves. Better to deal with them now than when they're the height and nearly double the weight of a cat, though a gray fox will always be easier than a big red one.

strings: s_c0 displays incredible skill, driving the mother vixen out of the territory almost by {PRONOUN/s_c0/self}. Now neither the gray fox nor her cubs pose a threat to the Clan. It places s_c0 as one of c_n's most talented and skillful fighters; a gray fox is a dangerous competitor.

strings: With so many cats working together in tight coordination, they're able to keep the gray vixen they find pinned and distracted as they wear her down. The fox eventually flees for her den, and the patrol follows to take care of the cubs she's raising.

strings: Bravely, s_c0 charges the gray fox, yowling threats. The vixen spooks and skitters up a tree, growling and barking in a squeaky tone, and s_c0 follows her up into the branches. As the rest of the patrol backs {PRONOUN/s_c0/object} up from the ground, s_c0 screams until the fox is cowering and afraid, then lets her flee.

strings: The patrol comes across a gray vixen at the end of the scent trail. She spots them too, measures herself up against them, then flees, scrambling up the cliffs of the headland in a move that completely surprises the cats. This round goes to the gray fox.

intro_text: As the cats move along the shoreline, they spot something massive moving beneath the water.
decline_text: The cats are feeling remarkably incurious today.

strings: It's Nessie! The patrol trots up, exchanging a nice mouse for a nice deep-water fish, both creatures trading the respective delicacies that are hard for the other to obtain.

The patrol is so wrapped up trying to work out what the creature is that r_c0 topples into the water. It solves the mystery though, as Nessie propels r_c0 back onto the shoreline with one gentle, immense flipper.

intro_text: p_l waves r_c0 over with {PRONOUN/p_l/poss} tail. What's that?!
decline_text: r_c0 isn't interested, and the patrol continues on their way.

strings: The massive frog-Twoleg creeps up the rocks, slow and unnatural. The patrol watches, breathless, until it's out of sight. Well, p_l huffs. Maybe toads grow bigger than {PRONOUN/p_l/subject} thought. Terrifying.

Frozen, the cats watch the massive lumbering frog, the size of a Twoleg and just as bipedal. It halts and, like the rumble of thunder, issues a massive croak that creaks like cracking wood. All r_c0 can do is shiver.
